novelty_basis: Elementary (the anchor is a right translation by a generator); folklore.
statement: If * on Z/N is associative and x*0 = x + 1 for all x, then x*y = x + y + 1; conversely this operation is associative and anchored. So every N has exactly one anchored associative magma (a cyclic group).
title: Anchored associativity forces x*y = x + y + 1, for every N
